title: Nscale raises $3.36 billion ahead of planned US IPO
teaser: Nscale, a British AI cloud company, said Friday it had raised $3.36 billion through convertible bonds, a financing round that highlights the capital required to build data centers for AI. The announcement comes a week after the company filed for an IPO in the United States. Nscale could be valued at $35 billion on the New York Stock Exchange, according to the Financial Times, while Bloomberg reports that it aims to raise $3 billion in the offering.
